Definition: to split or tear; figuratively, to upbraid
BiblicalUsage: Shaça' means to split or tear apart, and it is used for the hoof that is parted and the bird the priest cleaves in the offering. Samson tore the lion as he would have torn a kid, with nothing in his hand but the Spirit of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that strength in Scripture is never just muscle, because Samson tore the lion only when the Spirit came upon him.
